name: finds duplicate bytes across nested directories
input: two files with the same content in different directories
test:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    (root / 'docs').mkdir()
    (root / 'archive').mkdir()
    first = root / 'docs' / 'report.txt'
    second = root / 'archive' / 'report-copy.txt'
    first.write_bytes(b'same report')
    second.write_bytes(b'same report')
    (root / 'docs' / 'unique.txt').write_bytes(b'unique')
    assert find_duplicate_files(root, chunk_size=2) == [[str(second), str(first)]]

name: keeps empty-file groups but excludes same-size differences
input: three empty files and two distinct three-byte files
test:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    (root / 'nested').mkdir()
    empty_a = root / 'a.empty'
    empty_b = root / 'nested' / 'b.empty'
    empty_c = root / 'c.empty'
    for path in (empty_a, empty_b, empty_c):
        path.write_bytes(b'')
    (root / 'one.bin').write_bytes(b'abc')
    (root / 'two.bin').write_bytes(b'xyz')
    assert find_duplicate_files(root, chunk_size=1) == [[str(empty_a), str(empty_c), str(empty_b)]]

name: hashes files larger than a single chunk
test:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    payload = b'0123456789' * 100
    left = root / 'left.bin'
    right = root / 'right.bin'
    left.write_bytes(payload)
    right.write_bytes(payload)
    assert find_duplicate_files(root, chunk_size=7) == [[str(left), str(right)]]
